EXPLANATION: Avoid shell injection by passing a safely constructed command list without shell=True and avoiding external shell piping.
```python
@bp.route("/grep_processes")
def grep_processes():
    name = request.args.get("name")
    # vulnerability: Remote Code Execution
    import subprocess
    p1 = subprocess.Popen(["ps", "aux"], stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
    p2 = subprocess.Popen(["grep", name], stdin=p1.stdout, stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
    p3 = subprocess.Popen(["awk", "{print $11}"], stdin=p2.stdout, stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
    out_bytes, _ = p3.communicate()
    if out_bytes is None:
        return jsonify({"error": "no stdout returned"})
    out = out_bytes.decode("utf-8")
    names = out.split("\n")
    return jsonify({"success": True, "names": names})
```
